title: buy 与 sell：ETH 和代币的进出
mermaid:
sequenceDiagram participant U as 用户 participant BC as BondingCurve participant F as feeRecipient U->>BC: buy minOut 附带 ETH Note over BC: graduated 则 AlreadyGraduated
quoteBuy 扣 1% 手续费后报价 Note over BC: 少于 minOut 则 Slippage
超过 realTokenReserve 则 ExceedsCurve Note over BC: virtualEth 加 ethNet，virtualToken 减 tokensOut
feesAccrued 加 fee，balanceOf 用户加 BC->>BC: _checkGraduation U->>BC: sell tokensIn, minEthOut Note over BC: 先减用户余额并更新储备 BC->>U: call 转出 ethOut F->>BC: withdrawFees BC->>F: call 转出 feesAccrued
notes: 买入时 ETH 进合约、内部 balanceOf 增加，卖出时反向，手续费单独累计在 feesAccrued。
每笔交易都有 minOut 或 minEthOut 滑点保护，到手少于它就回滚。
代币只记在内部 mapping 里，不是 ERC-20，不能转账给别人。
sell 先改状态再转 ETH，防止重入。

title: 虚拟储备定价与毕业状态
mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
    state "曲线交易中 graduated = false" as Trading
    state "已毕业 graduated = true" as Graduated
    [*] --> Trading: constructor 设定虚拟储备
    Trading --> Trading: buy 价格上升
    Trading --> Trading: sell 价格下降
    Trading --> Graduated: realEthReserve 达到 graduationThreshold
    Graduated --> [*]: 发 Graduated 事件，禁止 buy 和 sell
    note right of Trading
        virtualEth × virtualToken = k
        tokensOut = virtualToken × ethNet 除以 virtualEth + ethNet
        realEthReserve = virtualEth 减 initialVirtualEth
    end note
notes: 起始价格来自虚拟 ETH，这部分 ETH 并不存在，只用来给出起始价格。
spotPrice = virtualEth × 1e18 / virtualToken，买入推高 virtualEth、压低 virtualToken，价格随之上涨。
本示例毕业时只发事件，不实现把 ETH 和预留代币迁移到 DEX 池。
